MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 6

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 17
   D. 27

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

6. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 1

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

10. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
